svg.text: Finance pays 9x entertainment in 2026; the top and bottom never swap.
This repo's RPM index: midpoint, $ per 1,000 views, mostly US audience. Log scale. Dashed = joined across a year with no evidence.
Someone comparing niches before starting, or
Whether a niche's pay is rising, falling or
A creator's own reported RPM for a niche
keeps landing far from its line
Read the order of the lines, not the slopes: two-point slopes are noise.
Read the order of the lines, not the slopes: two-point slopes are noise.
A line with two points moves as far as its two sources disagree. The order at the top (finance, then business and tech) and at
the bottom (gaming, entertainment) repeats every year it can be checked; the middle swaps. The quadrant plate turns this into a
choice: which niche pays well and is gaining on YouTube's own ad growth.
maintainer_estimate rows in data/<year>/benchmarks.csv: our own ranges, triangulated against sources whose terms forbid republishing
